notes: Inspected the 1536x1024 implementation capture recorded above. The primary screen renders as intended: header with the local-only indicator, Queue/Needs Review/Completed counts, the drop target and its supported-format list, the queue table with original name, status, proposed filename and confidence, and the review panel with filename, description, evidence rows for date, type and parties, the reason for review, and the Approve & rename and Keep original actions. Proposed filenames read in the documented format, date first and space separated. This capture supersedes 1eafb45aa782a47db9eeed58cf856a0760f6bc6648f50925588b92afc8bf400a: the one-sentence description now renders under the proposed filename in the queue and stays visible after a rename is applied, which it did not before - the description was rendered only while an item was ready or in review, so it disappeared exactly when the document was filed. Row heights grow only on rows that carry a description; the asserted geometry is unchanged and still passes at 1536x1024 and 1024x768. Scope: the implementation capture itself, not a pixel diff against the concept art, which remains on file at docs/design/intern-primary-screen.png.
